requirements.value: Applicant must have held a valid license in such state or province and been actively engaged in the practice of veterinary medicine for five years immediately preceding application; must pass an oral or practical examination, or both, as prescribed by the board; and submit other evidence of qualifications as required.
requirements.quote: The applicant has held a valid license in such state or province and been actively engaged in the practice of veterinary medicine for five years immediately preceding his or her application for licensure in this Commonwealth.

exists.quote: There is hereby established within the Department of State the State Board of Veterinary Medicine.

credential_type.quote: Any person wishing to practice veterinary medicine in this State shall obtain a license from the board and maintain registration.

is_mandatory.quote: Unless such person shall have obtained such a license it shall be unlawful for him or her to practice veterinary medicine as defined herein

title_protection.quote: uses any words, letters, or titles in such connection or under such circumstances as to induce the belief that the person using them is engaged in the practice of veterinary medicine and such use shall be prima facie evidence of the intention to represent himself as engaged in the practice of veterinary medicine

scope_protection.quote: Unless such person shall have obtained such a license it shall be unlawful for him or her to practice veterinary medicine as defined herein and if he or she shall so practice he or she shall be deemed to have violated the provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of any provisions of this act or any board rules and regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful or repeated violations of any provisions of this act or any of the rules and regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license, or presenting fraudulent evidence of qualifications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in the procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice veterinary medicine or presenting to the board dishonest or fraudulent evidence of qualifications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure to display a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The wilful failure to display a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deception, misrepresentation, dishonest or illegal practices in connection with the practice of veterinary medicine.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deception, misrepresentation, dishonest or illegal practices in or connected with the practice of veterinary medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making misrepresentations in the inspection of food for human consumption.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilfully making any misrepresentation in the inspection of food for human consumption.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently issuing or using health certificates, inspection certificates, vaccination certificates, or other forms used in veterinary practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently issuing or using any health certificate, inspection certificate, vaccination certificate, test chart or other blank forms used in the practice of veterinary medicine to prevent the dissemination of animal disease.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or dishonesty in applying, treating or reporting on any diagnostic or other biological test.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or dishonesty in applying, treating or reporting on any diagnostic or other biological test.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to keep equipment and premises of the business establishment in a clean and sanitary condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to keep the equipment and premises of the business establishment in a clean and sanitary condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to permit the board or its representatives to inspect the business premises.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to permit the board, or duly authorized representatives of the board, to inspect the business premises of the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Circulating untrue, fraudulent, misleading or deceptive advertising.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Circulating untrue, fraudulent, misleading or deceptive advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, gross negligence or other malpractice, or departure from acceptable and prevailing veterinary medical practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, gross negligence or other malpractice, or the departure from, or failure to conform to, the standards of acceptable and prevailing veterinary medical practice, in which case actual injury need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in practices in connection with veterinary medicine that violate standards of professional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in practices in connection with the practice of veterinary medicine which are in violation of the standards of professional conduct as defined herein or prescribed by the rules of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension or other disciplinary action by another state of a license to practice veterinary medicine or veterinary technology.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension or other disciplinary action by another state of a license to practice veterinary medicine or veterinary technology in that state on grounds similar to those which in this State allow disciplinary proceedings

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a violation of the Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a violation of "The Controlled Substance, Drug, Device and Cosmetic Act" in which case a record of conviction shall be conclusive evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor crime related to the profession or crime of moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor crime related to the profession or crime of moral turpitude in the courts of this State or any other state, territory or country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or allowing another to use his or her license for the purpose of treating or offering to treat sick, injured or afflicted animals.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting or allowing another to use his or her license for the purpose of treating or offering to treat sick, injured or afflicted animals.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of veterinary medicine under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of veterinary medicine under a false or assumed name or the impersonation of another practitioner of a like, similar or different name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Maintaining a professional or business connection with any person who continues to violate the act after written notice from the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Maintaining a professional or business connection with any other person who continues to violate any of the provisions of this act or rules of the board after ten days' notice in writing by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Addiction to habitual use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics or stimulants to the extent of incapacitation from professional duties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Addiction to the habitual use of intoxicating liquors, narcotics or stimulants to such an extent as to incapacitate him or her from the performance of his or her professional obligations and duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making any false statement as to material matter in any oath or affidavit required by this act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The wilful making of any false statement as to material matter in any oath or affidavit which is required by this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly maintaining a connection with or aiding any unlicensed person to practice veterinary medicine contrary to this act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly maintaining a professional connection or association with any person who is in violation of this act or regulation of the board or knowingly aiding, assisting, securing, advising, or having in the licensee's employment any unlicensed person to practice veterinary medicine contrary to this act or regulations of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish copies of patient medical records or radiographs upon proper written request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish a copy of a patient's medical records or failing to provide a patient's radiographs to another treating veterinarian, hospital or clinic upon the written request of an owner or owner's agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain required veterinary medical, surgical and/or diagnostic procedure logs and/or medical records.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain required veterinary medical, surgical and/or diagnostic procedure logs and/or medical records.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: To inspect all animal hospitals or veterinary establishments, including mobile clinics, at least biennially to determine sanitary conditions, physical equipment and methods of operation.

definition_quote.value: Practice of veterinary medicine includes, but is not limited to, the practice by any person who (i) diagnoses, treats, corrects, changes, relieves or prevents animal disease, deformity, injury or other physical, mental or dental conditions by any method or mode, including the prescription or administration of any drug, medicine, biologic, apparatus, application, anesthetic or other therapeutic or diagnostic substance or technique, (ii) performs a surgical operation, including cosmetic surgery, upon any animal, (iii) performs any manual procedure upon an animal for the diagnosis or treatment of sterility or infertility of animals...
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of veterinary medicine" includes, but is not limited to, the practice by any person who (i) diagnoses, treats, corrects, changes, relieves or prevents animal disease, deformity, injury or other physical, mental or dental conditions by any method or mode, including the prescription or administration of any drug, medicine, biologic, apparatus, application, anesthetic or other therapeutic or diagnostic substance or technique

veterinary_technician_certification_requ.quote: Unless authorized to practice veterinary technology under this act, an individual may not practice veterinary technology nor use the title "certified veterinary technician" or the abbreviation "CVT."

veterinary_technician_ce_hours_per_perio.quote: each holder of a certificate to practice veterinary technology under this act shall be required to complete sixteen clock hours of educational programs in the twenty-four months preceding each renewal date

technician_supervision_requirement.value: appropriate supervision of a licensed veterinarian as defined by board regulation
technician_supervision_requirement.quote: may practice veterinary technology under appropriate supervision of a licensed veterinarian as defined by board regulation

veterinary_assistant_recognized.quote: "Veterinary assistant" means an employe of a veterinarian who does not hold certification as a veterinary technician and whom the veterinarian deems competent to perform tasks involved in the care and treatment of animals as defined by board regulation.

veterinarian_client_patient_relationship.quote: "Veterinarian-client-patient relationship" means a relationship satisfying all of the following conditions: (i) the veterinarian has assumed the responsibility for making veterinary medical judgments regarding the health of an animal and the need for veterinary medical treatment

embryo_transfer_regulated.quote: removes any embryo from an animal for the purpose of transferring such embryo into another animal or cryopreserving such embryo

electronic_identification_implantation_i.quote: implants electronic identification, as determined by the board, upon any animal

mobile_clinic_recognized.quote: To inspect all animal hospitals or veterinary establishments, including mobile clinics, at least biennially to determine sanitary conditions, physical equipment and methods of operation.

medical_records_retention_required.quote: A veterinarian subject to the provisions of this section shall, as required by regulation of the board, keep or cause to be kept a written record of all animals or groups of animals, as the case may be, receiving veterinary services and provide a summary or copy of that record to the owner of the animals when requested.

exempted_activities.quote: This act shall not apply to: (1) Students in schools or colleges of veterinary medicine and programs of veterinary technology approved by the board

impaired_professional_program_available.quote: The board may defer and ultimately dismiss any of the types of corrective action set forth in this act for an impaired professional so long as the professional is progressing satisfactorily in an approved treatment program

mandatory_impairment_reporting_required.quote: Any veterinary establishment, peer or colleague who has substantial evidence that a professional has an active addictive disease for which the professional is not receiving treatment, is diverting a controlled substance or is mentally or physically incompetent to carry out the duties of his or her license shall make, or cause to be made, a report to the board

temporary_permit_available.quote: The board may issue, without examination, a temporary permit to practice veterinary medicine to an applicant for admission to the examination provided such applicant meets all conditions and requirements relating to the qualification of applicants for a license to practice veterinary medicine

out_of_state_consultant_days_per_year.quote: do not practice veterinary medicine as consultants rendering services directly to the public without the direction and consultation of licensees of this State more than 16 days per calendar year
